title: AVP: HUNT // HIVE canonical morphology and original-art release contract
intent: Keep every represented subject immediately and consistently recognizable while requiring a new, fan-made composition and excluding protected source imagery and performer likenesses.

normativeLanguage.should: expected unless the brief records a concrete visual reason

dimensions.requirement: The outer contour, posture, mass distribution and immediately readable family shape match the selected profile.
Limb count, joints, head construction, appendages and body proportions are internally coherent and match the selected profile.
Every required anchor is visible or unambiguously represented at the intended crop and scale.
Skin, shell, armor, fabric and mechanical surfaces follow the subject family rather than a generic fantasy or science-fiction substitute.
Relative scale and proportion are plausible for the subject and any nearby people, objects or architecture.
The pose reveals the morphology without tangles, fused limbs, hidden mandatory anchors or misleading foreshortening.
Named variants preserve their distinguishing features without collapsing into the generic family profile.

scoring.calculation: For each dimension, assign an integer rating from 0 through 100. Weighted score equals sum(rating * weight) / 100. No bonus or discretionary override may raise the result.
acceptance: every scoring dimension is at least 90
the accepted attempt is the final recorded attempt

hardFails.requirement: No official still, poster, concept art, promotional image, game capture, card, scan, texture or protected franchise asset may be supplied to the image model as an input or edit target.
The image may not recreate the camera, pose, lighting, staging or background arrangement of an identifiable official image.
No real performer, publicity portrait, face double or recognizable actor likeness may be requested or retained. Human faces must be original.
No official logo, wordmark, studio mark, legal line, card frame, packaging design, watermark or copied typography may appear.
Any false, absent, obscured or anatomically contradicted required anchor rejects the attempt regardless of score.
A generic monster, humanoid, weapon, vehicle or place that cannot be identified from morphology alone rejects the attempt.
Fused, duplicated, severed without narrative cause, impossible or illegible anatomy rejects the attempt.
Visible prompt fragments, gibberish lettering, labels, signatures or generation watermarks reject the attempt.
Any third-party image, texture, logo or asset without recorded permission or compatible license rejects the attempt.

originalityAndSafety.textualReferenceMethod: Use written morphology notes and independently authored prompt briefs. Do not attach official imagery to generation requests.
originalityAndSafety.identityRule: Fidelity applies to fictional morphology, equipment logic and environmental language; it never authorizes copying a protected image or a real person's likeness.
originalityAndSafety.humanCharacterRule: Named story roles are represented by original people with non-performer facial geometry, styling and pose.
originalityAndSafety.compositionRule: Camera, pose, grouping, light, weather and background must be newly designed for the card or scene.

rules: profile must resolve to exactly one morphology profile
requiredAnchors must contain every required anchor id from that profile exactly once
briefRevision starts at 1 and increases only when the brief is materially rewritten
the prompt must state every required prompt section
the negative prompt must explicitly reject official image copying, actor likeness, logos, text, watermarks and anatomical drift
no brief may define or override an acceptance score below 95

retryPolicy.attemptNumbers: attempt is globally sequential per asset; cycleAttempt is sequential from 1 through 6 inside one briefRevision
retryPolicy.afterSixRejectedAttempts: The image remains rejected. Rewrite the brief, increment briefRevision, set cycleAttempt back to 1 and continue at the same 95 point threshold.
retryPolicy.acceptedAttemptRule: acceptedAttempt points to the final attempt object; retryCount equals the number of preceding rejected attempts retained in attempts.
retryPolicy.targetedIterationRule: Each retry records the failed dimensions, failed anchors or hard fail and changes the prompt only where necessary while preserving already-correct morphology.

pendingMigrationState.purpose: Register an existing source asset before its first strict fidelity review without claiming acceptance.

ledgerPolicy.activeAssetUniqueness: Exactly one active ledger entry may exist for each kind/id pair.
